title: HiWave macOS trench — noon digest, night 15 (2026-07-14)
summary: Grid gutter bug named (shared rustkit-layout grid.rs:1632). image-gallery 12.88 -> 6.80 PASS with grid+font-metrics together; board flat 24/26 avg 7.1. PR #53 open, PR #52 merged. Pete: merge #53 standalone? greenlight text-metrics epic?
body:
# HiWave macOS trench — night 15 (2026-07-14)

**Metric:** board UNCHANGED on master — campaign 24/26 @ t15, avg 7.1 | holdout 6/6 | KF 7.
The real number: `image-gallery` 12.88 -> 6.80, PASSES t10 when the grid fix and the font-metrics `line-height: normal` model are applied TOGETHER. Standalone, the grid fix alone moves it 12.88 -> 13.60 (still known-fail, CI-safe) — shipped honestly, not hidden.

**Root cause:** `rustkit-layout/src/grid.rs:1632` — track sizing charged a spanning item's full size to the tracks alone and never credited the N-1 gutters BETWEEN the tracks it spans (css-grid-1 12.5). `span 2`, min-height 416, gap 16 -> rows sized 416/2 = 208 instead of (416-16)/2 = 200; the 8px compounded into every row below. After the fix: 416/200/200 EXACT vs Chrome. It survived because `test_spanning_item_distribution` hand-simulates the arithmetic in the test body and never calls the engine.

**The named unknown is closed.** Night 14 left 'at least one more coupling exists, named as unknown.' It was this — a grid gutter, NOT a line-height coupling. Under the metrics model every text box in image-gallery is exact vs Chrome. The text-metrics epic now has ONE named blocker left: the form-control recomposition (ATOMIC-IMPLEMENT 4.4).

**Commits:** hiwave-macos d8b8900 (PR #53, OPEN — shared crate, awaiting review); 4f847e8 (PR #52 instruments, MERGED, Prometheus-approved). Master otherwise untouched.

**Portable to other seats (Windows/Linux — shared rustkit crates):**
- The grid gutter bug is in the SHARED rustkit-layout crate — Windows and Linux inherit it. Any spanning grid item with a non-zero gap is oversizing its tracks today.
- Test smell worth sweeping for: tests that re-implement layout arithmetic in the test body and assert on their own local variables instead of driving the engine.
- Method that worked: two-model A/B probe (scripts/probe_text_metrics_coupling.py) — the two models produce structurally identical box trees, so the dumps join exactly on tree path; no selector plumbing needed to attribute a residual.

**Decisions for Pete (3):**
1. Merge PR #53 standalone, or hold it inside the atomic epic? Recommendation: MERGE IT — spec-correct, exact vs Chrome, de-risks the epic by removing its biggest confound, and cannot red-lock CI. Cost is 0.72pp on one already-noisy meter.
2. GREENLIGHT the text-metrics epic. Now backed by a measured payoff instead of a hope: grid + model together flip image-gallery to a PASS. 25/26 is one formula-shaped, already-specced blocker away (form-control recomposition). A 1-2 night unit, not open-ended.
3. Carried, still unanswered: isolate concurrent Atlas seats on the shared hiwave-macos checkout. Cheapest fix: allowlist git worktree on this seat.
